---
name: Task
about: One change, written so that it can be planned from the issue alone
---

<!--
Title: an action and its object, for example "Add the loader for the fact schema".
One change per issue. If the acceptance criteria grow past seven lines, split the issue.
-->

## Problem

<!-- What is missing or wrong, in one to three sentences. -->

## Why

<!-- Why this issue matters now. The reason limits the scope. A reason that would fit every issue, such as the order of the work, limits nothing. -->

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- One behavior per line, written as "When X, then Y". Each line becomes a test. Name the requirement ids in docs/spec.md that the lines cover. -->

- When

## Pointers

<!-- Files or modules, requirement ids, related issues and pull requests, and existing code to copy patterns from. Build details that are not in docs/spec.md go here. -->

## Non-goals

<!-- What is out of scope, and what must not change. When out-of-scope work moves to another issue, name that issue by its number. Otherwise, say only that the work is out of scope. -->

## Done means

<!-- The tests that are required, the documents to update, and anything else that must be true before the issue is closed. -->

## Risk tier

<!-- Low, medium or high. The definitions are in the pull request template. -->
